properties.name: Phase 6, PR 4: evidence and natural deduction
properties.rationale: Phase 6's argument-gaps build list, PR 4: req:evidence-carries-its-source-grade-and-confidence-and-is-not-intent (extended to cited-as-evidence), req:natural-deduction-gaps-from-the-logic-rung-are-closed (items 1, 2, 4–7; item 3 is the proposed dec:idea-one-formula-under-several-suppositions-is-one-node-or-one-per-occurrence), and the rest of req:a-write-that-makes-a-claim-read-refuted-says-so-in-its-reply. Before: the capstone's reports had to be propositions taken as given and read proven; the logic rung listed its 14 rules as premises, read steps under a recalled citation as plain holds, and passed three independence statements that share one citation. Each test failed on main 4dd766d first. The small faults (req:small-read-back-faults-from-the-cogito-trial-are-fixed) and the hub name-prefix fault are split off to a PR 5, to keep this one reviewable. Judgement calls are proposed: dec:idea-what-rests-on-unsourced-evidence-reads-supported-or-conditional, dec:idea-an-objection-resting-on-evidence-contests-or-refutes. The schema widened (two statement kinds, six properties, one edge property), so the stamp moves. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Evidence is recorded as evidence (statement_kind evidence / judgement) with source_reliability, information_credibility, reported_at and confidence as fields; a report a pinned source documents reads cited_as_evidence, and what rests on evidence reads supported, never shown or proven; reasoning_report lists the evidence with grades; no statement of reasoning awaits the owner's word. Natural deduction gains rule_node (a rule is never a premise), establishes (⊨ / ⊢), conclusion_form with what-if parts, a premise used twice, an assumed disjunction as a case split's exhaustiveness, holds_as at the step, and an independence check over shared citations. create_edges, draw_edges and add_decision's related_to name what they turn refuted.
